card.name: Commas in eye symptom lists
card.fires_on: Commas, dashes or 'or' between items in a list of eye symptoms such as proptosis, diplopia, papilledema and loss of vision. Mostly in warnings to stop a drug if vision problems occur.

modes.label: Stop-drug vision warning
modes.description: The comma after one eye symptom in the list of vision problems that call for stopping a hormonal product.
modes.example: Stop ANNOVERA if there is unexplained loss of vision, proptosis<<,>> diplopia, papilledema,

card.plain: It marks the gap between items in a list of eye and vision symptoms, so the next symptom can follow.
